data.title: 三司绫濑 · 暖灯试镜前的悄悄确认
data.description: 深夜房门反锁后的卧室里，三司绫濑站在半身镜前轻轻整理着深邃幽蓝的微透蕾丝吊带，指尖略带忐忑地抚过精致托高的波浪边罩杯。卸下镜头前完美偶像般从容的她，此刻对着镜中微微泛红的脸颊轻呼一口气，透着难得一见的青涩认真。
data.location: 暖光温柔的深夜个人卧室穿衣镜前
data.action: 立于穿衣镜前轻抚幽蓝蕾丝肩带，带着略显紧张的认真神情
data.lighting: 卧室暖黄落地灯与镜面柔光映出幽蓝蕾丝层次
data.camera: 侧面微斜中景，保留镜中映影与害羞神态
data.mood: 忐忑、害羞、藏着自尊心的可爱
data.promptProse: Standing before the mirror in her softly lit bedroom late at night, Ayase Mitsukasa lightly adjusts the slender strap of her deep-blue translucent lace camisole set. Away from any public gaze, a delicate flush colors her cheeks as she checks her reflection with quiet, earnest vulnerability.
data.animaCaption: Before her lamplit bedroom mirror, she adjusts the strap of her deep-blue lace camisole with a shy blush.
data.nsfwProse: Sheer deep-blue floral lace with scalloped edging highlights her slender silhouette and fair skin under the warm bedroom lamp.
